verdict.rationale: First-party SDK docs show sandbox.writeFile() and sandbox.readFile() for file I/O, and mkdir() for directories. A dedicated Files API covers reading, writing and managing files at absolute paths. writeFile() accepts a ReadableStream, which allows binary uploads larger than 32 MiB. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a dedicated download or streaming-read path for large or binary files, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the file APIs.
